review: Recovery27 short native inventory diagnostic terminal review

checks: Read-only run, job, decoded job-log and artifact APIs
Run caller, fixture checkout and single Mac job bindings
Exact decoded job log comparison with saved evidence
Exact structured experiment comparison with terminal receipt
Immutable fixture source readback for the failing test and NativeProcesses helper

soleFailure.predicate: The earlier single-PID row must be a member of a later rows(executable=path) result.

interpretation.primaryStop: An existing native candidate-inclusion unit assertion failed; this was not a fatal inventory-monitor stop.
interpretation.newInventoryTests: All tests other than the named existing NativeProcesses assertion passed, including the new Darwin inventory and stress-unit tests.
interpretation.monitorLimit: monitorFailure=null does not prove there were zero recovered timeout/race samples.
interpretation.gateLimit: The 60-second load experiment was not reached, so the short diagnostic gate is incomplete. No long trial is justified by this result.
interpretation.productLimit: This observation does not establish a Floorp compiler/product failure or the historical native-host exit cause.

staticAnalysis.twoPaths: The new resource inventory uses the bounded sysctl KERN_PROC_PGRP helper. The failing existing native discovery helper separately uses proc_listpids(PROC_UID_ONLY) and exact executable-path filtering.
possiblePredicateBranches: The target PID is absent from the later actual candidate enumeration.
The target is enumerated but a BSD read confirms gone/zombie, including a successful gone recheck after a RuntimeError, so rows skips it.
The target is enumerated but its current executable-path string differs from the independently obtained filter string.
The target returns a row whose birth or argv differs from the earlier row even though each independent read is internally consistent.
staticAnalysis.evidenceLimit: The safe failure identity and static frame do not retain assertion operands or the intermediate selection predicates. None of these branches can be selected from the current evidence.
staticAnalysis.capacityCaveat: The pinned XNU implementation allocates min(nprocs+20, caller capacity) before locking enumeration and can stop at that internal cap. Returning fewer bytes than the caller buffer therefore is not a general completeness proof. This known caveat is a hypothesis, not evidence that this run truncated.
staticAnalysis.lifecycleCaveat: The child is intended to wait on stdin, but the test has no explicit interpreter-ready acknowledgement or WNOWAIT observations bracketing the failed selection. Its stable waiting lifetime across the comparison was not recorded.

findings.description: The inclusion failure is safely identified but its failed predicate cannot be classified; raw assertion text should remain private.
findings.recommendation: Capture privacy-safe predicates from the actual selection call and project fixed outcomes through the public structured receipt.

observations: Add an explicit ready acknowledgement from the exact Popen child before comparison.
Bracket the actual selection with exact-child WNOWAIT status and distinguish live, exit-pending and unavailable without reaping early.
Wrap the actual pids/target BSD/path/argv selection calls to retain only candidate/filtered presence, equality booleans, fixed outcome kinds, counts and API bytes/errno.

Split candidate presence, filtered presence, birth equality and argv equality into independent static assertion lines so the existing frame projection can identify the failed predicate; preserve the strict final comparison.
Test safe projection and negative enumeration omission, row mismatch, unavailable/lifecycle and exact-child cleanup paths.
nextMinimalDiagnostic.privacy: Do not publish raw PID/UID/path/argv/environment, arbitrary exception text or full unittest logs. Printing safe diagnostics only inside unittest is insufficient because that output remains in the private test log.
nextMinimalDiagnostic.unchanged: Keep API permissions, selection, retry budgets, unknown handling and cleanup ownership unchanged; absence or unavailable reads must not become success.

reviewerPortableChecks.branchModels: Four local mock models reproduced the same inclusion-predicate failure without an escaping API exception: enumeration omission, path mismatch, authoritative gone and stable row change. These are branch models, not a reproduction of the Mac event.
reviewerPortableChecks.environmentUsable: Shell, repository reads and portable tests succeeded during review.

sdkPlanning.concern: A later consumer performs fresh acquisition and may begin after expiry. A legitimate unexpired acquisition path or separately reviewed reuse of content acquired while valid is required before a long trial; no expiry bypass or six-hours-remaining guard is justified.

notInScope: New short or long run activation
SDK or large artifact payload acquisition
Signing, publication, merge or permission changes

primarySource.supports: proc_listpids internal capacity calculation before proc_list_lock, UID filtering, live/zombie enumeration and returned byte count. This source does not identify which branch occurred on the hosted runner.
